subject: Request for one-time keep-alive package and SLA buffer — ZephyrAI renewal
messages:
From: Julian Lee <julian@zephyrai.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable <ap@zephyrai.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal conversation — pricing pressure and timeline

Vanessa,

Quick note — our renewal for ZephyrAI's standard plan is up on 11/30 and cost has become the single biggest concern from our CFO. Usage has grown ~2.6x year-over-year; the current quote pushes us outside our budget band. We like Redwood's latency and uptime, but we are evaluating a competitor who quoted a deeper discount + a standard SLA credit.

Can you confirm whether there are any one-time retention packages or credits you can offer? We need something concrete by 11/15 so procurement can sign off before month-end. If you prefer, I can share our most recent usage/export.

Cc'ing AP in case there are PO timing questions.

—Julian
Director of Platform, ZephyrAI

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Julian Lee <julian@zephyrai.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — pricing pressure and timeline

Julian — thanks for the transparency. We value ZephyrAI and want to keep you on Redwood. High level — we have two retention paths we can request approval for: 

1) Standard retention concession: 15% discount on list for 12 months + no SLA change. Fast approval (Deal Desk).
2) Escalated keep-alive package (requires exec approval): 22–25% discount for 12 months + one-time credit to offset overage for this year (proposal up to $50,000) + SLA addendum that bumps uptime commitment with a limited makegood calculation.

I can escalate option (2) to my leadership if you can confirm you need the full package vs. the standard concession. Also I’ve attached a usage snapshot in case it helps. I’ll loop in Deal Desk and Finance and get back by EOD Monday.

If you have a target number you’d like to see (discount or credit), share it and I’ll include it in the ask.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: zephyrai_usage_snapshot.csv
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: ZephyrAI renewal — exec approval request

Team — forwarding the customer note. TL;DR: ZephyrAI (growth SaaS) expects to pull if we can't materially reduce cost; renewal 11/30, need final number by 11/15. Customer prefers a one-time retention package with an SLA buffer.

Request: please authorize an escalated keep-alive package we can offer for signature that includes the following candidate terms: 
- 25% off list for 12 months (or authorized lower %)
- One-time credit: $50,000 applied against their next invoice
- Term reset to 12 months from signature
- SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime commitment with a capped remediation formula (draft attached)

Why: Revenue retention risk > $450k ARR; cost of churn (include onboarding & re-ingestion) is high and the customer is strategic for our AI benchmark references.

Attachments: proposed_keepalive_term.docx; sla_addendum-draft.pdf

Asks: Ben — can Deal Desk pre-clear this and flag Finance/legal items? David — any concerns on cost-of-service or capacity? Marissa — can you authorize an upper bound (discount or credit) so I can give the customer a firm offer?

—Vanessa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: ZephyrAI renewal — exec approval request

Vanessa — thanks for the context and the attachments. Quick thoughts: 
- Deal Desk can support, but Finance needs to confirm the one-time credit treatment and whether we can book it against current ARR retention spend. I’ll open a finance sync and pull P&L impact.
- Suggest limiting the one-time credit to $40k and authorizing a max discount of 22% (instead of 25%) unless Marissa wants to override.
- Require a 12-month firm commit and a standard renewal clause (auto-renew with 60-day notice).
- Legal should weigh on SLA language — specifically the remediation cap and whether it creates an ongoing liability. I’ll loop Legal if we proceed.

Can Finance respond by EOD Monday? If yes we can issue an approval memo for Marissa to sign off early Tuesday.

—Ben
Head of Deal Desk

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: ZephyrAI renewal — exec approval request

Team — I reviewed the ask and the customer profile. Given the churn risk and ZephyrAI's reference value, I authorize a conditional keep-alive package with the following limits: 

Approved concession (conditional):
- Discount: up to 22% off list for 12 months (no multi-year lock).
- One-time credit: up to $45,000 applied to the next invoice (cap).
- Term reset to 12 months from signature; must include a minimum spend commitment at prior ARR level (or higher).
- SLA addendum: approved only with explicit remediation cap (no open-ended liability). Finance & Legal must sign off on final wording.

Conditions:
1) Deal must be signed by ZephyrAI and countersigned by Redwood no later than 11/15/2026.
2) Finance to confirm credit accounting treatment (Ben).
3) Legal to approve SLA addendum language (Ben to loop Legal).
4) Include a clause that the concession is a one-time retention allowance and not precedent for future renewals.

Vanessa — please share this offer with Julian as the firm authorization. If ZephyrAI requests anything beyond the above, escalate back to me.

—Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
